subject: Specialized coverage trade request: distributed-systems panels
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Specialized coverage trade request: distributed-systems panels

Hi team,

I'm in a bind for tomorrow's Systems Infrastructure panel (distributed systems deep-dive). A client all-hands just pushed and I won't be able to cover the 11:00–12:30 slots. The candidate (Daniel Park) is fairly senior on his distributed systems background — we need someone who can evaluate design tradeoffs and latency/consistency thinking.

Offer: I can swap two ML infra panels next Tue/Wed (I already own those) in exchange for someone covering tomorrow's distributed-systems slots. I'll also prep a 15-min pre-brief and leave calibration notes in the candidate pack.

Concrete ask: is anyone able to pick up both 11:00 and 11:45 panels tomorrow? If you can take one but not both, please flag which one. If you prefer a shadow-swap (shadow first panel, then lead second), say so and I'll coordinate a shadow pairing.

Attachments: candidate-pack-DPark.pdf (candidate resume + notes)
Links: https://greenhouse.io/jobs/ACME-12345

Thanks — I know this is short notice.

—Camila
Camila Reyes | Senior Recruiting Partner, Redwood Inference
From: Michael Grant <michael@redwood.com>

Camila — thanks for the heads up. I can cover the 11:45 panel if Marcus can take 11:00. Marcus, can you confirm? If Marcus is OK, Camila please go ahead and move your ML infra panels to my calendar for next Tue/Wed (I prefer the Tuesday slot).

Jonas — if Marcus hasn't run distributed systems panels before, can you do a 10-min calibration with him at 10:30? Also adding Lauren to the loop in case we want a shadow pairing.

I've added a tentative calendar hold: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=interview-20270611

—Michael

I've uploaded the final candidate pack (candidate-pack-DPark.pdf) and interviewer slate (interviewer-slate-week-24.csv) to the candidate file in Greenhouse and added the calibration 10:30–10:45 hold to everyone's calendar. Marcus & Lauren — you should have a 15-min pre-brief on your calendars 30 minutes before the panel; it contains quick rubric bullets and sample questions (pre-brief-5min-agenda.txt).

Thanks again for being flexible — I owe you both coffee.
